simplifications.title: Receive first; authenticate for private work
simplifications.before: Portal activation blocks the first request.
simplifications.proposal: Capture existing-client email without requiring portal activation; offer a task link only when useful.
simplifications.guardrail: Routing is not authority; ambiguous identity goes to triage.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: One complete owner acceptance
simplifications.before: Scope, missing assets and dates are decided across separate messages.
simplifications.proposal: One acceptance panel shows outcome, agreement coverage, blockers, approver and proposed slot.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: One informed decision replaces repeated reconstruction.
simplifications.customerBenefit: Receives a clear commitment or a specific missing question.
simplifications.guardrail: Owner confirms price/date; no silent deadline recomputation.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Ask only what is missing
simplifications.before: Every service starts with another generic questionnaire.
simplifications.proposal: Reuse confirmed facts; show their age/source and ask only request-specific gaps.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: Less cleanup of repeated and conflicting information.
simplifications.customerBenefit: No repeated business description or account checklist.
simplifications.guardrail: Material facts remain confirmed by an appropriate person, never inferred silently.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Give a path when the customer cannot supply an asset
simplifications.before: A required upload blocks progress without help.
simplifications.proposal: Offer use existing / send later / help me prepare it, with scope/date effects.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: Can resolve the real blocker in one exchange.
simplifications.customerBenefit: Rough notes or assistance can be enough to start appropriate work.
simplifications.guardrail: Never invent content rights or add free deliverables without agreement.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: One conversation across channels
simplifications.before: Email, portal and private notes disagree.
simplifications.proposal: Each request has a shared history; internal notes remain explicitly private.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: No manual copy/paste between two editable systems.
simplifications.customerBenefit: Can reply in the channel already being used.
simplifications.guardrail: Business-scoped routing and attachments; no private-history disclosure to forwarded/unknown senders.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Review the change, not the whole project
simplifications.before: Clients search a large preview and acknowledge scope repeatedly.
simplifications.proposal: Show a short before/after, exact version and Approve / Request changes. Covered work needs no second scope acknowledgment.
simplifications.guardrail: Changed deliverables need new approval; reminder retries and private admin notes do not.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Make delays a choice, not a nagging loop
simplifications.before: Each overdue obligation produces another reminder.
simplifications.proposal: One consolidated reminder with a next-contact date, help option and delivery-slot consequence.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: Fewer chases that do not solve the problem.
simplifications.customerBenefit: Can say unavailable or need help without explaining repeatedly.
simplifications.guardrail: Silence never approves; alternate approver must be authorized.
simplifications.measure: Reminder count, replies and unresolved blockers.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Publish, verify and close in one view
simplifications.before: Owner moves among approval, deployment, checks and completion messages.
simplifications.proposal: One operator checklist links the approved artifact, deploy attempt, verification and receipt.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: Less tab switching and forgotten final steps.
simplifications.customerBenefit: Gets a verified result and a concise receipt.
simplifications.guardrail: Unknown outcome is reconciled; automatic retry never guesses.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Keep AI preparation inside the request
simplifications.before: A new AI inbox requires another daily review ritual.
simplifications.proposal: Put one editable summary and proposed missing questions beside the original request.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: Review in the same place as the actual decision.
simplifications.customerBenefit: No forced chatbot or extra customer queue.
simplifications.guardrail: AI failure leaves the original record and normal workflow usable.
simplifications.measure: Review minutes, correction rate and fallback success.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Use agreed routine messages
simplifications.before: Owner approves every acknowledgment or reminder.
simplifications.proposal: Preapproved templates use verified request facts and deterministic eligibility rules.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: No approval fatigue for routine coordination.
simplifications.guardrail: Novel promises, price changes and AI-written external replies still need review.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Make acceptance and payment separate facts
simplifications.before: Payment success is mistaken for readiness or permission to launch.
simplifications.proposal: Consult payment only when the agreement requires it for this work.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: No new checkout for already-covered changes.
simplifications.customerBenefit: No irrelevant payment barrier or surprise service suspension.
simplifications.guardrail: Distinct charges stay distinct; disputes need owner judgment.
simplifications.measure: Unnecessary payment steps and reconciliation incidents.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Use one business record with explicit memberships
simplifications.before: One email is treated as one customer business.
simplifications.proposal: People can belong to multiple organizations; each request has one organization and named approver.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: No duplicate account workaround for multi-brand clients.
simplifications.customerBenefit: One login with a clear business switcher.
simplifications.guardrail: Membership checked for each child resource; same email never merges businesses automatically.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Prefer fewer operating dependencies
simplifications.before: Several tools each hold a live copy of requests and scheduled jobs.
simplifications.proposal: One workspace database, one job dispatcher and one authoritative request record.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: Fewer synchronizations and failures to supervise.
simplifications.guardrail: Keep legacy inquiry intake until a reconciled cutover; no dual writable request copy.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Hand off in the format the customer uses
simplifications.before: A long unrequested training video gets ignored.
simplifications.proposal: Short written task guide first; offer a short video or call when useful.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: Less unused documentation work and repeat support.
simplifications.customerBenefit: Can find the two or three routine actions quickly.
simplifications.guardrail: Test with a fresh reader; maintain links and export access.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Keep the interface stable
simplifications.before: New features rearrange navigation and require retraining.
simplifications.proposal: Use the same request page and labels; progressively reveal detail.
simplifications.customerBenefit: Recognizable controls after a week away.
simplifications.guardrail: Test role-specific views, keyboard access and mobile recovery.
simplifications.measure: Return-visit task time and help requests.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

simplifications.title: Pause honestly when nobody is available
simplifications.before: Automations keep promising progress during absence.
simplifications.proposal: Show service coverage, next update and authorized substitute or pause.
simplifications.ownerBenefit: No hidden obligation that keeps escalating unattended.
simplifications.customerBenefit: Knows when a person will respond and what changes to the date.
simplifications.guardrail: No invented 24/7 support or automatic reassignment to an unauthorized person.
simplifications.measure: Overdue commitments without a named plan.
simplifications.implementation: V2 Business §§5–13; Technical §§6–14; launch scope (not contingent on live clients)

aiUses.input: Authorized request text plus confirmed organization facts.
aiUses.output: Three lines: desired outcome, known constraints, unresolved questions; each linked to source.
aiUses.authority: Draft only; never change confirmed facts.
aiUses.fallback: Show original message and a blank structured brief.
aiUses.success: Owner preparation time falls without material missed constraints.
aiUses.implementation: V2 Technical §13 / B12 / V230; all seven evaluated helpers implemented before release

aiUses.input: Current accepted agreement version and new request.
aiUses.output: Included / likely extra / unclear candidates with evidence and draft response.
aiUses.authority: Owner decides scope, price and schedule.
aiUses.success: No invented allowance, price or customer commitment in the accepted result.
aiUses.implementation: V2 Technical §13 / B12 / V230; all seven evaluated helpers implemented before release

aiUses.input: Current request prerequisites and available assets.
aiUses.output: One consolidated question, acceptable examples and optional help paths.
aiUses.authority: Cannot mark access, rights or consent as confirmed.
aiUses.success: Fewer clarification exchanges and no unnecessary account-access requests.
aiUses.implementation: V2 Technical §13 / B12 / V230; all seven evaluated helpers implemented before release

aiUses.input: Comments tied to the current preview version.
aiUses.output: Suggested grouped edits, conflicting feedback and proposed next action.
aiUses.authority: Named approver resolves conflicts; model cannot approve or silently merge different decisions.
aiUses.fallback: Read the original comments in order.
aiUses.success: Less sorting time; no omitted rejection or changed requirement.
aiUses.implementation: V2 Technical §13 / B12 / V230; all seven evaluated helpers implemented before release

aiUses.input: Verified request state, attempted actions and active commitment.
aiUses.output: Brief of what is needed, what was tried and why human attention is needed.
aiUses.authority: Cannot extend dates, impersonate a substitute or decide priority from sentiment alone.
aiUses.success: Owner can act without rereading the whole thread; critical commitments remain visible.
aiUses.implementation: V2 Technical §13 / B12 / V230; all seven evaluated helpers implemented before release

aiUses.input: Verified published artifact and check results.
aiUses.output: Plain-language receipt and optional task guide.
aiUses.authority: External AI-written text requires review; factual template can be preapproved.
aiUses.fallback: Deterministic receipt with actual URL/version and support route.
aiUses.success: No success claim before verification; fewer repeated how-to questions.
aiUses.implementation: V2 Technical §13 / B12 / V230; all seven evaluated helpers implemented before release

aiUses.input: Aggregated operational measures with unnecessary personal data removed.
aiUses.output: Suggested causes of rework and one improvement experiment.
aiUses.authority: No autonomous policy changes or customer promises.
aiUses.success: A measured reduction in effort after the chosen change, including maintenance.
aiUses.implementation: V2 Technical §13 / B12 / V230; all seven evaluated helpers implemented before release

priorImplementation.treatment: Historical sequence only. Superseded by V2 complete-build stages and B01–B15; no paid pilot prerequisite.

priorImplementation.gate: Pass authorization, duplicate, stale-approval, takeover and publication-recovery tests.

priorImplementation.treatment: Historical sequence only. Superseded by V2 complete-build stages and B01–B15; no paid pilot prerequisite.

priorImplementation.gate: Compare against manual baseline on real held-out cases; review time plus corrections is lower, with no material factual omissions.
priorImplementation.rollback: Turn off AI adapter; retain original messages and templates.
priorImplementation.treatment: Historical sequence only. Superseded by V2 complete-build stages and B01–B15; no paid pilot prerequisite.

priorImplementation.gate: Shared identity/history stays consistent; separate service scope, account access and measurement gates pass.
priorImplementation.rollback: Keep unsupported services on the proven manual process; do not promise broad automation.
priorImplementation.treatment: Historical sequence only. Superseded by V2 complete-build stages and B01–B15; no paid pilot prerequisite.

priorRecords.invariant: Not inferred from an email domain; shared parent ownership does not imply shared access.
Current server-checked membership; fixed owner/contributor/approver relationships initially.

priorRecords.purpose: Accepted service, scope and commercial terms
priorRecords.invariant: Versioned agreement and covered work; website, SEO and ads remain separately scoped.

priorRecords.purpose: Desired outcome, current state, approver, commitment
priorRecords.invariant: One organization and one canonical record; optimistic version for concurrent changes.
Organization/request-bound; visibility explicit; provider IDs unique.

priorRecords.purpose: Metadata, private object key, checksum, safe-processing state
priorRecords.invariant: Received is not usable; no cross-organization signed links or permanent public buckets.

priorRecords.purpose: Immutable preview/deployable artifact and configuration manifest
priorRecords.invariant: Stable revision ID/digest; mutable preview URLs alone are insufficient.

priorRecords.purpose: Decision, revision, actor, time and scope shown
priorRecords.invariant: Append-only decisions; named authority; no silence-as-approval.
Unknown is distinct from failed; published artifact must match approved version.

priorRecords.purpose: External invoice/charge IDs and reconciled state
priorRecords.invariant: Provider remains financial source of truth; distinct genuine charges never deduplicated away.

priorRecords.purpose: Deduplicated inbound event and processing status
priorRecords.invariant: Unique provider/event ID; durable receipt precedes acknowledgment.

priorRecords.purpose: Intent, operation key, lease, retry count, state, takeover epoch
priorRecords.invariant: Transactionally created with business transition; recheck eligibility before effect.
Compact append-only evidence; avoid logging unnecessary message content or secrets.

priorRecords.purpose: Export time, record counts and file/artifact hashes
priorRecords.invariant: Restorable set tested independently; retention and deletion policies include backups.

priorRoutes.requirements: Invite-only session, organization switch, clear next action and all outstanding obligations; private/no-store responses.
Membership and resource scope; saved feedback; explicit current preview; accessible status.
Owner-only access with MFA; due work stays visible alongside failures and blockers.
Validated user context, organization membership, bounded payload and idempotent submission.
Owner role; expected request version; accepted scope/prerequisites/approver/date in one transaction.
POST only, CSRF protection where relevant, current membership, named authority and immutable revision check.
Authorize organization and parent request; short-lived signed access or streamed response; safe content headers.
Verify signature on the required raw body; deduplicate and persist before queueing retrieval; no user session expected.
Provider signature, durable event ID, current-object reconciliation; no redirect-derived paid status.
Owner-only conditional transition; invalidate pending automation epoch, expose in-flight work, resume explicitly.
Owner-only; current approval, revision and capacity checks; operation ID, actual deploy result and independent verification.
